title: Sara Duterte trial: Verdict before Dec. 16 'not entirely accurate,' says Escudero
summary: Trial presiding officer Francis Escudero on Monday clarified the statement issued by the Senate impeachment court's spokesperson last week, saying it was "not entirely true."
